sources.observation: The official UAE homepage timed out after receiving 15835 bytes (HTTP 200); the preserved partial HTML is readable and explicitly titles the page Citibank UAE, describes UAE banking products, identifies Organization name Citibank UAE, Dubai address and +971 customer support, and identifies this exact logo URL. The subsequently completed logo retrieval decodes as a 102x59 WebP despite the .png URL; actual model image inspection shows the blue Citi letters and red arch with no accompanying bank name, slogan, or enclosing cyan field. Partial HTML is not represented as a successful full-page transfer.

The complete current group homepage was downloaded via the root redirect. Its header contains an img with an original base64 SVG data URI, width 204 height 118, five path elements, blue #255BE3 and red #FF3C28. The page also references Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call materials. The decoded original vector was preserved separately for research and independently rasterized with rsvg-convert; actual image inspection shows the same complete blue Citi/red-arch geometry as the local UAE logo and the direct candidate. This is group geometry evidence, not UAE applicability by itself.

sources.observation: The fetched Commons file page dates the artwork 1 March 2023, credits Citigroup, and links citigroup.com/global as its source; upload history is 5 November 2023. The original file is a 2104-byte SVG with paths/rectangles and no raster payload. Its colors are rgb(37,91,227) and rgb(255,60,40), identical to the current official header. Its path geometry and actual independently rendered image agree with that primary original vector, supporting an original-vector reproduction rather than traced raster artwork. The complete emblem consists only of the Citi lettering and arch, with no accompanying title/tagline.

sources.independenceGroup: Zona Logo distribution of Citi original artwork
sources.observation: The downloaded page lists two observed original SVG download URLs in its AssetItem publicUrl properties. The dark-named file is actually blue #255BE3 letters/red #FF3C28 arch; the light-named alternative has white lettering and is not the selected UAE color variant. The selected direct 2038-byte SVG has a normal XML declaration but no DTD/entity declarations or raster payload, five original path/rectangle elements, and a 0 0 172 100 viewBox. Its complete geometry and colors match the independently inspected original vector embedded in the current official Citigroup header; this direct source is not a manually stripped or rewritten Commons asset. Its independent rsvg-convert PNG was actually read and shows the matching whole emblem. Original-vector provenance is supported by this geometry lineage and primary-source corroboration, not by the distributor's filename alone.
